scene: The glowing bamboo activates three transport gates across the breezy park platform.
picture: Flat side view along the wooden deck. On the far left sits a steaming noodle-cart monorail. Left of centre, the player stands holding the glowing green bamboo shoot. At centre, a paper-lantern balloon floats tethered by ropes. On the far right, a glowing neon escalator steadily hums, moving upward into the sky.
